title: Electron-gain enthalpy
basic_overview: Electron addition depends on size, Z_eff and repulsion in the receiving orbital.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Compact 2p orbitals can make F less favourable than Cl for first electron gain.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Compare size. 2. Compare Z_eff. 3. Check compact/paired orbital. 4. Apply sign convention in the question.
extra_info_content.factors: F has strong electron attraction but extra repulsion in compact 2p; Cl often has more favourable first electron gain.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
